title: Blue drum murder case: Judge invokes 'Mahabharata' while giving death penalty
content: A Meerut court has sentenced Muskan Rastogi and her lover Sahil Shukla to death for murder. They were found guilty of murdering Muskan's husband, Saurabh Rajput, and hiding evidence. The trial included the testimony of 22 witnesses and numerous hearings over 18 months. Rajput’s mother expressed her gratitude for the verdict, hoping it deters future crimes. Both convicts were sentenced after their trial concluded on Wednesday.

title: 'Why are you ruining nation?' Dipke heckled, called 'CIA agent' at Delhi airport
content: Dipke landed in Delhi a day after his party's co-convenors, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, surreptitiously climbed a gate at the prohibited area of Jantar Mantar to protest against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)  Gyanesh Kumar and the government, which has denotified Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site. Later, Das and Ranka were sent to 5-day judicial custody on the order of Delhi's special executive magistrate court.

title: How Jeff Bezos turned 165,000 acres of Texas ranchland into Blue Origin’s launch site
content: Jeff Bezos acquired 165,000 acres of land in West Texas to develop Blue Origin's spaceflight operations. The company launched its first crewed flight on July 20, 2021, with four passengers aboard. This historic mission marked significant milestones in commercial space travel and the efforts to expand human access to space. Blue Origin aims to make space travel available for more people beyond government programs.

title: 3 Indians killed in Germany fire, 5 injured; resident arrested on murder suspicion
content: The victims were two women aged 25 and 27, and a 26-year-old man, German public broadcaster WDR reported, citing Bochum police. Their identities and home states in India have not been disclosed. The five injured people suffered smoke inhalation and were taken to hospitals in Bochum. Their nationalities have not been reported.

title: India's WPI inflation surges to 11.39% in September on higher food, fuel prices
content: India's wholesale price index-based inflation surged to 11.39% in September due to higher food, manufactured items, and energy prices. Wholesale inflation has risen significantly amidst global commodity inflation linked to the ongoing West Asia conflict. The rising costs have impacted various aspects of the economy, including the manufacturing sector and consumer prices. Retail inflation also increased to 5.54%, marking its highest level in 23 months.

title: 700 supermarkets hit, millions lost: France warns refrigeration cyberattacks may persist
content: A cyberattack targeting refrigeration systems at supermarkets in France has led to significant disruptions in food supply chains. The attack, which occurred on Monday, affected approximately 700 supermarkets, causing spoilage and financial losses. Authorities warn that the cyber threats might still be active, urging retailers to enhance their security measures. Investigations are ongoing, but no group has claimed responsibility for these incidents.

title: Tyler Perry turned 330-acre former Army base into major Atlanta film studio
content: In 2015, Tyler Perry acquired the former Fort McPherson Army base in Atlanta for $30 million, and transformed it into a major production hub featuring 12 sound stages. This initiative not only aims to create new jobs but also emphasizes the importance of preserving historical structures while meeting the evolving demands of the film industry. Perry’s vision includes nurturing local talent to foster growth in South Atlanta's creative landscape.

title: US ends 540-day grace period for immigrants after work authorisation expires
content: In a significant policy shift, the US Department of Homeland Security has abolished the 540-day automatic extension for work permits. This development results in immediate loss of work authorization for many, particularly affecting H-4 visa holders and asylum seekers, even while their renewal applications are pending. Moreover, the USCIS continues to face notable delays in processing these renewals, leading to a legal challenge from impacted parties contesting the new regulation.

title: Cardboard garden beds cut weed cover to 15% by second season in USDA trial
content: Weeds can significantly impact crop yield, leading to a need for effective control methods. A USDA-funded trial demonstrated that cardboard beds reduced weed coverage compared to tilled beds. Farmers found that using cardboard made weeding easier and more efficient after two growing seasons. The results from the trial showed varied crop yields when grown in different bed types.

title: 'Few things to work on': Mandhana flags improvement areas ahead of Champions Trophy
content: The India women's cricket team is set to be led by Smriti Mandhana in a series against Zimbabwe commencing on October 16. Aimed at refining their skills for the Women's Champions Trophy in February 2027, Mandhana emphasized the significance of learning from competitors and establishing solid team standards. She shared insights on their successes and highlighted aspects needing improvement.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ Volunteer for 15 program promotes youth community service.
content: Brittany and Patrick Mahomes foundation, 15 and the Mahomies collaborated with Youth Volunteer Corps for Volunteer for 15 program. Several young people have contributed countless hours and raised millions over the past four years. The kids learn about people from different background, racial equity, and environmental disasters. They spend more time in community service.

title: Travis Kelce's 87 Running Foundation helps rebuild former athlete's 56-year-old home
content: Gloria White’s home was rebuilt by Travis Kelce’s foundation. She had stayed there for 56 years. She was 79 years old when she sought help for her Kansas City home.

title: New York mayor pauses plan to loosen demolition rules for historic buildings
content: Saratoga Springs Mayor John Safford has paused changes to historic building demolition rules following community backlash. Opposition arose during a public hearing where residents and preservationists expressed their concerns. The current demolition safeguards will remain while the city reviews its development regulations. Safford intends to revise other parts of the development rules despite the current pause. A City Council public hearing is scheduled, allowing further community input on proposed amendments.

title: Pierre Cardin restored ruined Provence château into music and theatre venue
content: Since its acquisition by Pierre Cardin in 2001, Château de Lacoste has seen remarkable renovations. This historic castle, once associated with the Marquis de Sade, is now a vibrant performing arts hub, hosting the annual Festival de Lacoste. This festival showcases opera, dance, and classical theatre in an enchanting open-air amphitheatre.

title: Selena Gomez’s Rare Impact Fund has raised over $30m, reaches 3.5m youth a year
content: Selena Gomez's Rare Impact Fund is dedicated to advancing youth mental health resources and education across the globe. Having already generated over $30 million, the fund collaborates with 30 nonprofits on five continents. Its goal is to raise $100 million to broaden mental health care accessibility. Recent events have gained traction, drawing support from various corporations and celebrities, highlighting the need for ongoing community engagement to meet these ambitious targets.

title: DeAndre Jordan raised $100,000 for Harvey relief, donated 400 pairs of shoes
content: DeAndre Jordan leveraged his position in the NBA to make a significant impact on Hurricane Harvey victims in Houston. Through his Rebounds to Rebuild campaign, he raised funds based on his rebounds this season. Additionally, he donated shoes to students at Thompson Elementary and founded a reading club to enhance literacy, supporting families affected by the disaster and showcasing the positive influence athletes can have in their communities.

title: Kenneth Walker reveals Andy Reid's impact on Chiefs' winning streak
content: Kenneth Walker opens up on how Chiefs’ head coach Andy Reid has helped the team to remain unbeatable in the new season.

title: ‘Avoid argument with wife’: Greater Noida man falls to death from 21st floor
content: Harshit Lavania fell from the 21st floor of a residential building in Noida, resulting in his death. His estranged wife arrived at his flat and tried to gain entry after he refused to engage. In an attempt to avoid confrontation, he reportedly tried to move between balconies before losing his footing. Medical personnel declared him dead upon arrival at the hospital.

title: Blue drum case: From brutal murder to death penalty; how horrifying case unfolded
content: Muskan Rastogi and her lover Sahil Shukla were sentenced to death for the murder of Saurabh Rajput. Rajput's dismembered remains were found in a blue drum filled with cement in March 2025. The prosecution presented extensive evidence including forensic reports, call records, and witness testimonies during the trial. Following the verdict, Rajput’s mother expressed her gratitude for the justice served.

title: Steve Harvey went from sleeping in car with $35 to funding $700,000 in scholarships
content: Steve Harvey faced significant financial struggles in the early 1990s, paving the way for his journey to becoming a prominent entertainer and philanthropist. He founded the Steve & Marjorie Harvey Foundation, which has invested over $700,000 in college scholarships, catering to youth from low-income families. Additionally, the foundation emphasizes mentorship programs aiming to cultivate leadership skills among the young, creating numerous opportunities for underprivileged communities throughout North America.

title: Historic 36-room Houston mansion sold; preservationists fear uncertain future
content: The historic Kirby Mansion in downtown Houston has officially changed hands, now owned by OB Texas Properties LLC. This 100-year-old structure holds significant historical importance, once housing the Red Cross. Preservationists express concern over its future due to its lack of formal historic designation, while ongoing discussions between Preservation Houston and the new owners moots possible preservation options. The mansion's fate remains uncertain until further plans are disclosed.

title: Starlink row: Govt to examine satellite internet, says parl panel chief Nishikant Dubey
content: The Indian parliamentary panel will soon discuss satellite internet services following Elon Musk's allegations about market access and opposition. Musk claims powerful business interests are obstructing Starlink's entry into India while urging competition. The government has rejected these allegations, stating security and regulatory requirements are crucial. BJP MP Nishikant Dubey emphasized security agencies' concerns regarding Starlink's operations.

title: Ohio brothers bought flooded quarry for $330,000; village later drops seizure bid

title: Muskan Rastogi, her lover Sahil Shukla sentenced to death in blue drum murder case

The prosecution labeled the crime as one of the rarest of rare cases requiring the death penalty.

Despite struggling with homelessness, she imparted profound lessons on resilience and the importance of community support. Encouraged by her unwavering belief in his basketball dreams, Harrison now gives back generously, embodying the spirit of hope and determination that she instilled in him for others facing adversity.

This sale sets a new benchmark in the world of basketball collectibles, emphasizing the increasing importance of sports memorabilia in popular culture.
